TVU? → TVUJ requires J (canonical 7 if eventually supported), not a q/g substitution. The overwritten first group ?BDH?ELA → OBDRZELA remains a hypothesis.
Question-shaped source marks remain unknown-role masks in the source record; the working text proposes their interrogative role from Czech syntax. CH assignments remain conditional.

The repeated se se is retained. The whole text joins consecutive source rows in their recorded order. No calendar date, health fact, actual meeting, sender identity or nickname identification is authenticated.

The language hypothesis includes N/M and H/R repairs, DNCS → DNES (C/E), missing C/K/Z and the precise spans in the linked ledger. Selected ciphertext/literals stay unchanged.
Božím těle / Corpus Christi is a proposed reading of BO?IN TELE requiring Z and M; no calendar date or actual holiday encounter is established.
Joining lower4 MOHU SE to margin1 TESITI is an editorial order proposal supported by sentence syntax; the raw spatial regions remain separate.
Question-shaped source marks remain unknown-role masks; Czech interrogative punctuation is editorial. CH remains conditional. No diagnosis, real meeting or identity is authenticated.
